messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly signalboard: wins, risks, asks (Nov 13–20)

Team — sharing the condensed weekly signalboard ahead of Monday's leadership sync. Short bullets + asks at the bottom. Happy to expand on any line items in the meeting.

Wins
- Hosted API P95 latency: down 12% week-over-week after batching/kv-cache tweak (see weekly-metrics-1113.csv). This improves SLA headroom for our mid-market tier.
- Dedicated: closed initial POC with Acme Corp; signed MOU for Dedicated pilot (see acme-poc-ma-plan.pdf). Will start provisioning next week.
- Redwood Optimize: two customers adopted suggested quantization profile (int8) — observed ~22% token cost reduction in staging.

Risks / Open issues
- Dedicated autoscaler: intermittent tail-latency spikes on long-context LLMs during autoscale events. Root cause appears to be a race in the drain path; infra has a mitigation branch but we need timed validation.
- Eval regression: small but repeatable drop in rouge for model "rwd-13b-v2" on the docs-eval suite after the optimizer patch. Research is triaging.
- Procurement: Acme's legal is asking for a 45-day data retention exception in their SOW. Security/compliance flagged; will need leadership decision on precedent.

Asks / Decisions needed by EOD Mon 11/16
- Approve short-term Dedicated capacity delta (+1 shard on pilot pool) to guarantee throughput for Acme POC (cost for the month estimated in attached MOU). Approver: Finance + Infrastructure.
- Direction on data-retention exception: approve a Scoped Exception (pilot-only, encrypted, logs retained 30 days) or decline and propose standard policy? Approver: Security + Legal (cc'd).
- Prioritization: allocate 2 FTE from infra to validate autoscaler fix next sprint or accept a temporary conservative autoscale cap. Approver: Product + Infra leads.

Action items (owners)
- Irene: coordinate provisioning and vendor onboarding for Acme (start 11/17).
- Vivek: provide cost delta and sign-off for +1 shard by Mon EOD.
- Laura: confirm QBR material updates; need canary plan for deploy if we approve autoscaler fix.

Attachments: weekly-metrics-1113.csv, acme-poc-ma-plan.pdf

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Platform Ops | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly signalboard: wins, risks, asks (Nov 13–20)

Thanks Irene — good rundown. Quick responses inline:

- +1 shard for the Acme pilot: can approve conditionally if procurement confirms MOU covers trial billing and we get a clause capping spend to the pilot scope. I asked ProcureOps to confirm.
- Autoscaler: can infra attach the mitigation branch to a canary that has synthetic long-context traffic? Prefer validation in staging + small canary before prod change.
- Data retention exception: I do not want a permanent precedent. Scoped exception acceptable for pilot only; need Security + Legal to document the controls.

Vivek
VP, GTM Ops

Quick recap and outcomes from the week (closing the loop):

Decisions made
- Finance approved +1 shard for the Acme pilot for Nov (conditional); procurement confirmed MOU billing clause and a $TBD cap on pilot usage. Deal: D-8942-Acme.
- Security approved a scoped data-retention exception for Acme (pilot-only, encrypted, logs retained 30 days). Legal will send language and sign-off.

Autoscaler path forward
- Infra will run the mitigation branch in staging this week with a synthetic long-context canary (owner: Markus). If results look stable we will do a 48-hour prod canary with an automatic rollback trigger at 2x baseline P95.

QBR / material updates
- I've attached the QBR heatmap (qbr-heatmap-nov20.pdf) with a one-slide summary for "latency improvements" and the Dedicated pipeline status. Laura, see the proposed canary plan on slide 2 — happy to iterate.

Action items (closed/open)
- Irene: Provisioning kickoff with Acme scheduled 11/23 (owner: Irene) — OPEN.
- Markus: Run staging canary by 11/22 and report results (owner: Markus) — OPEN.
- Vivek: Confirm monthly cost cap and approve +1 shard by 11/20 EOD — CLOSED (approved conditionally).
- Marissa: Prep a short blurb for the leadership QBR on cost optimization wins — OPEN (due 11/24).

Attachments: qbr-heatmap-nov20.pdf

Thanks everyone — will post the canary telemetry in the leadership channel as results come in.

—
